items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 19 at 2:38PM PST until November 19 at 9:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northwest winds 10 to 20
kt with gusts up to 35 kt expected.

* WHERE...Monterey Bay.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 9 PM PST this
evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 19 at 12:02PM PST until November 20 at 4:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 18 to 24 ft with up to 30 ft at
favored break points.

* WHERE...All Pacific Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 4 AM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Large breaking waves can overpower swimmers, pulling
people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks resulting
in significant physical injury and increasing the risk of
drowning. Waves can sweep across the shoreline without
warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks.
items.instruction:
Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.
